<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.7.1/jquery.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.8.0/gsap.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.8.0/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/split-type"></script>

<script>
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  ScrollTrigger.defaults({
    markers: false,
  });

  // Enhanced Circle Animation with Mobile Responsiveness
  $(".sticky_circle_wrap").each(function (index) {
    let triggerElement = $(this);
    let targetElement = $(".circle");

    // Function to get responsive values based on screen size
    function getResponsiveValues() {
      const screenWidth = window.innerWidth;

      if (screenWidth <= 480) {
        // Small mobile
        return {
          initialWidth: "90%",
          initialHeight: "33em",
          initialBorderRadius: "1em",
          finalHeight: "68vh",
          scrollStart: "top center",
          scrollEnd: "bottom center",
        };
      } else if (screenWidth <= 768) {
        // Large mobile/Small tablet
        return {
          initialWidth: "90%",
          initialHeight: "40em",
          initialBorderRadius: "4em",
          finalHeight: "88vh",
          scrollStart: "top top",
          scrollEnd: "bottom bottom",
        };
      } else if (screenWidth <= 1024) {
        // Tablet
        return {
          initialWidth: "45em",
          initialHeight: "35em",
          initialBorderRadius: "4.5em",
          finalHeight: "100vh",
          scrollStart: "top top",
          scrollEnd: "bottom bottom",
        };
      } else if (screenWidth <= 1200) {
        // Tablet
        return {
          initialWidth: "45em",
          initialHeight: "35em",
          initialBorderRadius: "4.5em",
          finalHeight: "100vh",
          scrollStart: "top top",
          scrollEnd: "bottom bottom",
        };
      } else {
        // Desktop
        return {
          initialWidth: "60em",
          initialHeight: "40em",
          initialBorderRadius: "5em",
          finalHeight: "90vh",
          scrollStart: "top top",
          scrollEnd: "bottom bottom",
        };
      }
    }

    // Function to create/update animation
    function createAnimation() {
      const values = getResponsiveValues();

      // Kill existing timeline if it exists
      if (window.circleTimeline) {
        window.circleTimeline.kill();
      }

      window.circleTimeline = gsap.timeline({
        scrollTrigger: {
          trigger: triggerElement,
          start: values.scrollStart,
          end: values.scrollEnd,
          scrub: 1,
          invalidateOnRefresh: true, // Recalculate on resize
          refreshPriority: -90,
          onUpdate: function (self) {
            // Optional: Add custom mobile touch interactions
            if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
              // Add subtle scale effect on mobile for better feedback
              const progress = self.progress;
              const scale = 1 + progress * 0.02; // Subtle scale
              gsap.set(targetElement, { scale: scale });
            }
          },
        },
      });

      window.circleTimeline.fromTo(
        targetElement,
        {
          width: values.initialWidth,
          height: values.initialHeight,
          borderRadius: values.initialBorderRadius,
          scale: 1,
        },
        {
          width: "100%",
          height: values.finalHeight,
          borderRadius: "0px",
          scale: 1,
          duration: 1,
          ease: "power2.inOut",
        }
      );
    }

    // Initial creation
    createAnimation();

    // Debounced resize handler
    let resizeTimeout;
    $(window).on("resize", function () {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
      resizeTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
        createAnimation();
        ScrollTrigger.refresh(); // Refresh ScrollTrigger
      }, 250);
    });

    // Mobile-specific touch enhancements
    if ("ontouchstart" in window) {
      targetElement.on("touchstart", function (e) {
        gsap.to(this, {
          scale: 0.98,
          duration: 0.1,
          ease: "power2.out",
        });
      });

      targetElement.on("touchend touchcancel", function (e) {
        gsap.to(this, {
          scale: 1,
          duration: 0.2,
          ease: "power2.out",
        });
      });
    }
  });

  // Additional mobile optimizations
  $(document).ready(function () {
    // Optimize for mobile performance
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
      // Reduce motion for better mobile performance
      gsap.config({
        force3D: true,
        nullTargetWarn: false,
      });

      // Add viewport meta tag if not present (for proper mobile scaling)
      if (!$('meta[name="viewport"]').length) {
        $("head").append(
          '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">'
        );
      }
    }

    // Handle orientation change on mobile
    $(window).on("orientationchange", function () {
      setTimeout(function () {
        ScrollTrigger.refresh();
        window.circleTimeline && window.circleTimeline.invalidate();
      }, 500);
    });
  });
</script>

settings.member_details:
Jon Pepper is a trusted expert in technology project delivery, rescue, and assurance, with over 20 years’ experience leading complex, high-stakes initiatives. He is the Founder and Managing Director of Maintain Technology, a trusted leader in helping enterprise organisations avoid failure in high-stakes SAP and technology projects, delivering expert project assurance across all stages—from inception to recovery.

Jon is widely trusted by critical industries—including government, defence, health, and utilities—for his ability to deliver outcomes in challenging environments. Through his leadership and hands-on delivery expertise, he has helped clients save over $100 million by rescuing troubled programs, streamlining project execution, and assuring strategic alignment.

He also serves as the Integrated Release Delivery Lead for SAP S/4 at Defence Australia, overseeing the end-to-end delivery of SAP S/4HANA and SAP SuccessFactors solutions. Jon leverages his deep expertise in business process design, project planning, and design thinking to drive large-scale transformation and deliver lasting impact.
Karla builds high-performance teams with heart. She leads recruitment, culture, and capability development—ensuring every team we deploy is aligned, accountable, and ready to move mountains.
A mission-driven strategist and storytelling powerhouse, Airen shapes our brand with authority and authenticity—amplifying the voices, wins, and values behind Maintain’s impact.

settings.description_text: We take the helm of complex programs from day one — ensuring strategic alignment, stakeholder buy-in, and measurable impact. Our program leaders stabilise delivery, restore confidence, and keep your mission moving forward.

Whether you're deploying SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, or both, we architect systems that are scalable, secure, and future-ready. We cut through complexity to align technical build with business value.
We own the deployment runway — planning and executing seamless go-lives with military-grade precision. We ensure data integrity, business continuity, and operational readiness at every checkpoint.
Clean data. Clear insights. We establish robust governance frameworks and streamline integration across systems, departments, and partners — enabling smarter, faster decisions.
We align enterprise tech with commercial reality — reshaping operating models to boost agility, margins, and service efficiency.
People are at the heart of every transformation. We embed human-centred design to drive system adoption, streamline workflows, and reduce friction in high-change environments.
